title: FBI warns about Kimsuky hackers using QR codes to phish U.S. orgs
clean_text: Here's a heads-up from the FBI regarding Kimsuky's latest tactics. The North Korean state-sponsored hacker group, Kimsuky , is actively deploying malicious QR codes within spearphishing campaigns targeting U.S. organizations. This marks an evolving initial access vector to watch out for. Technical Breakdown: Threat Actor: Kimsuky (North Korean state-sponsored). Attack Vector: Spearphishing campaigns primarily aimed at U.S. organizations. Malicious Technique: Embedding malicious QR codes in phishing emails. These codes likely lure victims to credential harvesting sites, deploy malware, or compromise accounts. Defense: Implement robust email security filters, conduct user awareness training focusing on QR code vigilance and unsolicited links, and maintain up-to-date endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions. Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fbi-warns-about-kimsuky-hackers-using-qr-codes-to-phish-us-orgs/
